serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Vanta Trust Management Platform provides customers with an end-to-end security and compliance automation suite that focuses on the following activities: continuous and automated governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), vendor risk management, questionnaire automation, and up-to-date security program description displayed on the customers’ Trust Center website. In addition, Vanta works closely with customers and selected audit partners to help streamline compliance against 30+ security compliance frameworks such as System and Organization Controls (SOC) 2, International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, ISO 42001, National Institute of Standards and Technology Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (NIST AI RMF), CIS CSC, NIST CSF, FedRAMP, and more. With over 10,000 customers and countless automations, Vanta serves as a continuous monitoring solution to ensure organizations reach and maintain a state of security.
